newsitem.title: USA: Adaptec exec says comfortable with forecast.
newsitem.headline: Adaptec exec says comfortable with forecast.

text.p: Adaptec Inc Treasurer Christopher O'Meara on Monday said the company is comfortable it can meet analysts' estimates of $0.47 a share for its fiscal fourth quarter ending March 31.
In March last year, Adaptec posted fiscal fourth quarter earnings of $0.37 a share and fiscal year earnings of $1.31.
After a speech at the Robertson, Stephens conference here, O'Meara also told Reuters Adaptec is comfortable with the investment firm's estimate of $2.08 a share in fiscal 1998.
If it earns $0.47 a share in 1997's March quarter, it should report fiscal year 1997 earnings of $1.70 a share.
